title: The Refusal
narrative_summary: The narrator confronts his childhood friend, who heard the story on the bus and still refuses, after decades, to repeat it because he believes telling it would cause the narrator's death.

opening_visual.description: The empty rural road in overcast light with thin mist near the tree line; the narrator seen from behind in his charcoal overcoat, exactly as episode 1 ended.
opening_visual.continuity_link: Same road bend, bus-stop post left, tree line right; narrator in the same posture as the final frame of episode 1.

closing_visual.description: The friend sits motionless at the kitchen table under the single warm lamp, half his face in shadow, while the hallway doorway at the right edge of the frame remains dark.
closing_visual.hands_off_to_next: Episode 3 opens on the dark doorway, which becomes the narrow vertical light strip of the overhearing threshold.

visual_progression.description: Continuity from episode 1, then an ordered, controlled kitchen that feels slightly too still.
Softer, lower-contrast flashback that withholds the story and shows only the huddle of listeners.
Frames narrow from a medium close-up to extreme close-up, then release into a wide with the doorway dominating the right side.
A near-static final image in which stillness carries the dread.

continuity_notes: The kitchen doorway is on the right of the table in every kitchen scene.
The friend's green scarf is the same muted green as the bus seats (#5B6B58 family).
The narrator's face is never shown.
The story's content is never visualised.

narration.text: I went back to the one person I knew had heard it.

characters.notes: Same posture as final frame of episode 1.

camera_movement.rationale: Quiet resolve; a slight approach toward the decision.

environmental: thin mist drifting left to right

transition_out.rationale: Time and distance between the road and the friend's home.

narration.text: Marcus never mentioned that day on the bus. Not once, in all those years.

narration.text: He was there. He heard every word. I wasn't.

narration.text: I asked him to tell me. He said no.

narration.text: He said that if he told me, it would kill me.

scenes.narrative_purpose: Deliver the central statement with maximum restraint; no visual shock.
scenes.visual_description: Extreme close-up of the friend's hands resting on the wooden table, fingers pressed together, one thumb slowly pressing into the knuckle of the other hand. Everything beyond the hands falls into darkness.

camera_movement.rationale: Stillness gives weight to the line; movement would soften it.

lighting.key_source: hanging lamp directly above the table

layers.motion: slow thumb press and release, 2 cycles

transition_out.rationale: Cut on the end of the line without softening it.

narration.text: Decades later, he still won't say it. He would rather I hate him than bury me.

transition_out.rationale: A softer release before the final held shot.

narration.text: He kept his silence. And I kept wondering what he was keeping from me.
